prompt.alinti: This new open source model from Google lets you predict anything in the future. This is TimesFM, Google's new AI model for time series forecasting trained on 100 billion real-world data points. Think stock prices, your sleep score, or even your business and sales forecast. Until now, you will have to train a separate model with your own data every single time, which takes weeks and costs a ton of money. But this AI flips it completely. You just give it your historical numbers and it forecasts the future with zero training required, because it already learned the patterns from billions of real data points. And it doesn't just tell you what will happen. It also tells you how confident it is. So instead of a single number, you get a full range from best case to worst case and everything in between. So wanna check it out? Just comment 'model' and I will send you the link.
